title: Improving Contextual Retrieval for Long Documents using Semantic Chunking and Hybrid Retrieval Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2611.08498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The vast amount of information available in lengthy, distributed documents makes finding relevant answers difficult, especially when the answer requires connecting evidence from multiple sources. Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often struggle with this type of "multi-hop" reasoning and frequently face issues with context fragmentation. In this paper, we propose a hybrid RAG framework that integrates the structured reasoning of knowledge graphs with the broad semantic coverage of dense vector retrieval. Our approach employs a multi-stage pipeline using transformer-based summarization and semantic chunking to improve context retention. We construct a dynamic knowledge graph to capture explicit relationships between entities while simultaneously maintaining a dense vector index. During inference, the system uses a hierarchical mechanism that prioritizes graph traversal for precision and falls back to vector retrieval

translated_title: 使用语义分块和混合检索策略改进长文档的上下文检索
translated_abstract: 篇幅冗长且内容分散的文档中包含的海量信息使得查找相关答案变得困难，尤其是当答案需要连接来自多个来源的证据时。标准的检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常难以应对这种“多跳”推理，并且经常面临上下文碎片化的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种混合RAG框架，该框架将知识图谱的结构化推理与稠密向量检索的广泛语义覆盖相结合。我们的方法采用多阶段流水线，利用基于transformer的摘要生成和语义分块来改善上下文保留。我们构建了一个动态知识图谱来捕获实体之间的显式关系，同时维护一个稠密向量索引。在推理过程中，系统使用分层机制，优先进行图遍历以保证精确性，并在需要时回退到向量检索。
tldr: 该论文提出一种混合RAG框架，通过知识图谱结构化推理与稠密向量检索相结合，配合语义分块和分层检索机制，有效解决了长文档多跳推理中的上下文碎片化和检索精度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid RAG framework that combines knowledge graph-based structured reasoning with dense vector retrieval, leveraging semantic chunking and a hierarchical retrieval mechanism to address context fragmentation and improve retrieval precision for multi-hop reasoning over long documents.
